question: A boy walking at the rate of 4 km per hour crosses a square field diagonally in 36 seconds. What is the area (in m²) of the field?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** in m/s = 4 × (5/18) = 10/9 m/s.

**Diagonal** (Distance) = Speed × Time = (10/9) × 36 = 40 m.

**Area of Square** = (Diagonal²) ÷ 2 = (40 × 40) ÷ 2 = 800 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 800 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the boy = 4 km/hr

Time taken to cross diagonally = 36 seconds

**Formula used:**

1. Distance = Speed × Time

2. Speed (m/s) = Speed (km/hr) × (5/18)

3. **Area of square** = (Diagonal²) / 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7cf22146561a591f7118bc5738bc2433ba74d1ce88843e05a053168e668c716.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 4 × (5/18) m/s = 10/9 m/s

⇒ Length of the **diagonal** = Speed × Time

⇒ Diagonal (d) = (10/9) × 36 = 10 × 4 = 40 m

⇒ **Area of the square field** = d² / 2

⇒ Area = (40 × 40) / 2

⇒ Area = 1600 / 2 = 800 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 800 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Diagonal and Side Relationship

In a square, the diagonal (d) is related to the side (a) by the formula: d = a√2.

Area Formulas for Square

Area can be calculated either as (Side)² or (Diagonal²) ÷ 2.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
